operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run typecheck
operations.recovery: Hosted Oncall coordinates incidents alongside the customer's existing pager with paging OFF; keep the existing pager routes authoritative and continue through them and the team's incident process if coordination is unavailable. Retain exact source, the private .rer/deploy deployment record, private secrets and every applied migration byte. Hosted D1 and local .wrangler/state are separate stores: export the hosted database with wrangler d1 export --remote before changes, restore only into a fresh empty installation, and verify the owner, schedules and incident records before switching traffic. Imported pending timers stay paused because delivery is OFF; sessions and credentials never transfer. See OPERATIONS.md.

specInputs.recovery: Hosted incident coordination runs beside your existing pager. Paging is OFF; there is no independent standby or delivery guarantee. Signed-in admins can export coordination records from Archive. rer export and rer import recover local installation data; see docs/data.md and docs/checkpoints.md.
